source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Invisible Woman (archived 25 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Cosmic rays bombarded her on the Fantastic Four's space flight; Reed believes her power is energy drawn from the higher dimension of Hyperspace.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.detail: Bends visible, infrared and ultraviolet light around herself or others, hiding up to about 40,000 cubic feet at once while still seeing normally.

abilities.name: Psionic force fields
abilities.detail: Projects invisible force fields from 1 mm up to domes miles wide, tough enough to briefly withstand blasts from Galactus and the Mad Celestials.

abilities.name: Force blasts
abilities.detail: Fires her fields as concussive shockwaves that push crowds back, wreck rooms of machinery and once blew a hole through Hydro-Man's chest.

abilities.name: Flight and telekinesis
abilities.detail: Rides force-field platforms through the air and uses precise fields to lift heavy equipment, take machines apart or set bones.

abilities.name: Internal force fields
abilities.detail: Can form fields inside a target or object, knocking people out, blocking arteries or blowing Doombots apart from within.

abilities.name: Psychic shielding
abilities.detail: Her fields shut out psychic powers, once stopping Jean Grey's telekinesis and keeping Psi-Lord from reading her mind.

abilities.name: Combat and spycraft
abilities.detail: Trained in judo by Reed and in staff fighting by Iron Fist, and secretly trained as a S.H.I.E.L.D. covert agent.

feats.text: Her force fields, helped by the Cosmic Control Rod, carried the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom and Annihilus safely through a black hole.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Unlimited Vol 1 3

feats.text: Wrapped herself, then Jean Grey, in force fields that shut out Jean's telekinesis and ended her attack on the people around them.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Fantastic Four Vol 1 286

feats.text: Kept an entire Negative Zone planet invisible for an extended time.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Annihilation - Scourge Omega Vol 1 1

feats.text: Shielded civilians from rubble, then wrapped a force field around the giant Giganto's head until he passed out and fell.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: While in labour she seized the Silver Surfer in a force field, slammed her against walls and hurled her into lava.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

feats.text: Held Galactus in place with her force fields and pushed him toward the teleportation bridge to save her son, collapsing from the strain.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
